summary: Nanoviricides, Inc. filed Amendment No. 1 to its prospectus supplement, amending its at-the-market (ATM) offering with D. Boral Capital LLC. The filing updates the maximum amount of common stock sellable under its Form S-3 registration statement, reducing it to zero due to SEC's General Instruction I.B.6 one-third public float limit. The company had sold approximately $9.84M of shares in the prior 12 months. This is a routine shelf mechanics filing, not a special situation.
